title: exhibit/v1
description: targets/<id>/review/exhibits/<id>.json beside <id>.lean (F26-R1, R4, R13; D-9 v3.39): one kernel-checked result the gate's review job wrote — a compile, a screen, an intent test on a candidate, a pair direction, a mutant's result, or a format-rule return — with the toolchain and Mathlib it ran under and the run that wrote it. Only exhibits are evidence for a grade (D-9 v3.12); a brief is a judgement and never an exhibit. Written only by the job, never by hand. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

target.description: the target the record is filed under

candidate.description: the candidate (or the mutant's parent) the exhibit is about

test.description: the intent test, for an intent-test exhibit; the pair's other candidate for a pair exhibit; null otherwise

result.description: what the kernel said: for a candidate, pass or fail (a fail discards it); for a direction, proved, refuted or open; `returned` for the format rule; `error` when the check could not run, which decides nothing

detail.description: one line: the screen that fired, the case and probe, the instance that refuted, the concept written inline

lean_file.description: the Lean the kernel checked; null for a `returned` or `error` exhibit

run.description: the job run that wrote it (a workflow run id or `local`)

id.description: the record's id, lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens; a candidate's is `c-<8 hex>` of its Lean's sha256, a test's `t-<8 hex>`, a question's `q-<n>`, an exhibit's `e-<8 hex>`
